title: ラスト・サークル・ディフェンス
author: 五十嵐 チーム

en.title: Last Circle Defense
en.premise: A handball club that has lost its former glory, now composed only of clumsy members and substitutes who were 'chosen by no one.' Lacking a star ace, they take on the powerhouses with absolute organizational strength and precise analysis from the bench. This is a story of a 'complementary sport,' where victory is found not in individual talent, but in filling the gaps in one another.

zh.title: 最后的圆阵防御
zh.premise: 曾经辉煌的手球部如今已失去光芒，成员尽是些“无人问津”的替补和笨拙的部员。在缺乏王牌球员的情况下，他们凭借极致的组织力与替补席上的缜密分析，向强豪发起挑战。这不是关于个人才华的故事，而是一场关于“互补之运动”的物语——用彼此的缺失，填补对方的空白。
